title: Recipe agent (no tools)
description: Full recipe for the picked idea. Prompt: prompts/recipe.md. Runs only after the pick. Can run again with change requests from the pack or macro step. The model picks foods and grams only; packs, macros and cost are code.

pack_hints.description: Typical pack sizes, e.g. 'chicken breast: 500 g pack'.

idea_id.description: Copied from the picked idea. Code rejects a recipe for another idea.

note.description: Optional. One short line for the cook about the whole recipe.

name.description: Plain English food name, the exact known_ingredients name when listed.

units_per_serving.description: Eggs only (size M, 51 g each); 0 for everything else.

pantry.description: Salt, pepper, dried spices and herbs, oil, vinegar: assumed at home, not bought, still counted in macros.

dry.description: True for rice, pasta, quinoa and couscous, whose grams are dry (uncooked) weight.

note.description: Optional short note, e.g. 'dry weight' or 'drained'.

leftover_plan.description: Optional. Accept a fresh leftover and use it in another meal instead of growing the portion.
